privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
What data we collect: name, email address or phone number, and message text that you provide through the contact form.
Purpose: we use this data solely to respond to your inquiry and discuss potential cooperation.
Data storage: your messages are stored in our email inbox and are not transferred to third parties.
Retention period: we retain correspondence for up to 12 months or until you request deletion.
Your rights: you can request access to, correction, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting us at hello@coderatti.studio.
